title: The Shim Syndicate — Master Registry
description: Canonical version registry for The Shim Syndicate. This file tracks which version of the Syndicate is active and provides a complete audit trail of version history. Every project hydrated from this core records this version at hydration time.

versions.description: Pre-commit .env.example false-positive fix. CHECK-3's secrets-scan .env-file guard matched any filename containing ".env." as a substring, which incorrectly blocked .env.example — the standard, recommended, secret-free template file every dotenv-based project commits to document required environment variables. Discovered live: mission/actual-budget-provider (mcp-gateway) could not commit a completely safe, no-real-values .env.example, blocked by the same guard meant to catch real .env files.
changelog: hooks/pre-commit: added is_env_example_file() helper — matches .env.example, .env.sample, .env.template (and *.env.example-style variants), exempting them from CHECK-3's hard-block .env-file guard.

hooks/pre-commit: the guard's exemption applies only to the filename-based hard block, not to the regex secret-content scan — a real secret accidentally pasted into a .env.example file is still caught.
Real .env files (.env, .env.local, .env.production, etc.) are unaffected — still hard-blocked exactly as before.

versions.description: Idempotent Governance Regeneration (data-loss fix). syndicate-init.sh's project-level and mission-vault generation steps (ORACLE.md, TEST_DOCTRINE.md, project-map.json, AUDIT_LOG.md, MISSION_BRIEF.md, RESERVATIONS.json) now skip regeneration if the destination file already exists, instead of unconditionally overwriting it every invocation. This bug predates central governance mode but was previously just a local annoyance (manually restored via git checkout before committing); with central mode's new auto-commit hooks (v3.9.0), it became a live data-integrity bug that destroyed a real project's committed task/ADR history in one command.
changelog: scripts/syndicate-init.sh: Steps 4 (ORACLE.md), 4.1 (TEST_DOCTRINE.md), 4.2 (project-map.json), and 5 (AUDIT_LOG.md) — project-level generation — now check `[[ -f "$DEST" ]]` first and skip with an info log if the file already exists, rather than blindly overwriting operator-edited or accumulated content on every run (including every routine `--mission` invocation, the normal way this script gets called repeatedly across a project's lifetime).

scripts/syndicate-init.sh Step 12 (mission-vault generation): the same idempotency check applied to all 6 generated files (MISSION_BRIEF.md, mission ORACLE.md, mission project-map.json, RESERVATIONS.json, mission TEST_DOCTRINE.md, mission AUDIT_LOG.md) — re-running `--mission` on an already-active mission branch (a legitimate, common action, e.g. resuming a session) no longer wipes operator-filled mission content.

Discovered live: running `--mission` for a new mission on mcp-gateway regenerated the PROJECT-level (not mission-level) governance files from blank templates, and the new central-mode auto-commit (v3.9.0) committed that blanked state directly to syndicate-projects before it was noticed — destroying 7 completed tasks and 8 ADRs. Restored from git history in the downstream repo; this fix addresses the root cause in the core.

Verified via real scratch-fixture testing: hydrate + fill in real content + re-run --mission twice (both project-level and mission-vault-level), confirming all 10 previously-vulnerable files survive intact across repeated invocations.

versions.description: Centralized Governance by Default. syndicate-init.sh gains --governance central|colocated (default: central for fresh hydrations, auto-detected from an existing .syndicate symlink/directory otherwise). Adds hooks/post-commit and hooks/post-merge + scripts/sync-governance.sh so governance changes are captured and pushed to the central syndicate-projects repo automatically, regardless of which downstream repo they're attached to — no manual commit/push step required. Adds scripts/syndicate-migrate-governance.sh to formalize co-located-to-central migration (previously a manual, ad-hoc procedure).
changelog: scripts/syndicate-init.sh v2.2.0: new --governance {central|colocated} flag and SYNDICATE_PROJECTS_PATH env var. Auto-detects mode from an existing .syndicate path when the flag is omitted (symlink -> central, reusing its exact target rather than recomputing one; real directory -> colocated; neither -> central, the new default for fresh hydrations). Refuses to silently clobber an existing setup if the explicit flag conflicts with it. Central mode creates governance at $SYNDICATE_PROJECTS_PATH/<project>/, symlinks .syndicate to it, updates .gitignore to a full ignore, registers the project in the central repo's README Projects table, and commits directly in the central repo (both at project hydration and at mission-vault creation, since those moments have no downstream-repo commit yet to hang a sync hook off).

hooks/post-commit and hooks/post-merge (new) + scripts/sync-governance.sh (new): after every commit or merge in a downstream project using centralized governance, automatically commits (and by default pushes) any pending changes in the central governance repo, scoped to that project's own subdirectory plus README.md — never a blind git add -A that could sweep in another project's unrelated in-progress work. Designed to never fail loudly: every error path (no network, push rejected, central repo dirty with conflicts) logs a warning and exits 0, so a governance-sync problem can never block the developer's actual commit/merge. SYNDICATE_GOVERNANCE_NO_PUSH=1 opts out of the auto-push, committing locally only.

hooks/pre-commit v2.5.0: CHECK-1 now also treats a commit as merge-context when .git/MERGE_HEAD is present (not just SYNDICATE_MERGE_CONTEXT=1) — fixes a real gap found in testing: when pre-merge-commit blocks a merge (e.g. on a CHECK-2/5 failure) and the operator retries via plain `git commit` to complete it, that retry was being misidentified as a fresh direct commit to main/master and incorrectly blocked.

scripts/syndicate-migrate-governance.sh (new): formalizes the co-located-to-central migration procedure (previously performed by hand for the mcp-gateway project) — SHA-256 hash-verified zero-data-loss move, symlink creation, .gitignore block replacement (actively replaces stale colocated-style ignore content rather than skipping if any Syndicate block is already present), idempotent central README registration, and a scoped commit in the central repo. --dry-run is genuinely non-mutating.

All new/changed pieces tested against real scratch fixtures, not just static review: init.sh central mode (fresh hydration + mission mode + auto-detection with a deliberately mismatched SYNDICATE_PROJECTS_PATH, which caught and fixed a real bug where registration would target the wrong central repo), the post-commit/post-merge hooks (real commits and a real blocked-merge-then-retry scenario, which caught and fixed the pre-commit MERGE_HEAD gap above), and the migration script (which caught and fixed a real stale-comment-residue bug in its .gitignore replacement logic).

versions.description: Merge-Commit Gate Fix. Adds hooks/pre-merge-commit — closes a gap where merge commits into any branch (including main/master) silently bypassed every Gavel pre-commit check (branch guard, secrets scan, prohibited patterns, test doctrine, shim schema). Discovered empirically in a downstream project: a git merge into master produced zero Gavel output while a direct git commit was correctly blocked. CHECK-1 (branch guard) is merge-context-aware so the sanctioned mission-branch-merge workflow is not blocked by the fix that closes the gap.
changelog: Added hooks/pre-merge-commit — Git invokes this hook (not pre-commit) for merge commits; without it, no Gavel check ran on any merge. New hook sets SYNDICATE_MERGE_CONTEXT=1 and delegates to hooks/pre-commit, so secrets scan, prohibited-pattern guard, test doctrine, and shim schema validation now all run on merge commits, matching the guarantee the docs already claimed for 'every commit'.

hooks/pre-commit v2.4.0 CHECK-1: merge-context-aware. A merge landing on main/master (SYNDICATE_MERGE_CONTEXT=1) is no longer treated as a direct-commit violation — merging a mission/ branch into main/master is the sanctioned path per MISSION_BRIEF.md merge criteria. Instead verifies the incoming branch is a mission/ branch and PASSes; a non-mission or unidentifiable source WARNs (does not block) — an unidentifiable source must never be able to block the sanctioned workflow.

hooks/pre-commit CHECK-1: source-branch identification uses SYNDICATE_MERGE_SOURCE (caller-set) as the authoritative signal, with a best-effort `git name-rev --name-only MERGE_HEAD` fallback. Empirically, .git/MERGE_HEAD is NOT reliably present when pre-merge-commit fires for a clean (non-conflicting) merge under git 2.43 / the `ort` strategy — verified by direct .git/ inspection at hook-fire time (only AUTO_MERGE and ORIG_HEAD were present). Relying solely on git plumbing here would have silently degraded to always-WARN on the exact git version/path this fix targets.

Dogfooded against downstream project mcp-gateway (regression check: direct commit to master still blocked; mission-branch merge with SYNDICATE_MERGE_SOURCE set now shows a real Gavel PASS/CHECK-1 pass; non-mission-branch merge source correctly WARNs, does not block). All test branches/commits reverted after verification — no residue left in mcp-gateway.

versions.description: Branch Hygiene Script. Adds scripts/branch-hygiene.sh — a self-contained pi operative for investigating and remediating GitHub PR branch health. Derives the GitHub repo from git remote automatically; embeds a 7-step protocol with 6 failure classes; applies the operative.mimo.md intent shim to stay scope-locked. Accepts an optional CI_FACTS_FILE for project-local CI chain integration.
changelog: Added scripts/branch-hygiene.sh — runs as a pi operative (opencode/mimo-v2.5-free). Takes PR_NUMBER and optional CI_FACTS_FILE. Derives repo from git remote. Embeds protocol with 7 steps: CI status check, no-CI diagnosis (stale commits / behind main / conflict), full local CI chain run, fix-all, verify-all, commit+push, report. Covers 6 failure classes: stale pre-merge commits, branch behind main, merge conflict (STOP+REPORT), CI violations, no runs+mergeable (empty trigger commit), unclassified (STOP+REPORT). Applies intent-shims/operative.mimo.md to suppress executor drift.

versions.description: Gate Hardening II. Phase 3 of the Consigliere remediation: closes the residual findings parked in the review addendum — secrets-scan breadth with gitleaks delegation, multi-word prohibited-pattern support, an opt-in strict mode for evidence-bound trailers (the C-2 flag-day migration path), pi-shim model verification annotations, and removal of the permission-bypass default. No identity files modified.
changelog: hooks/pre-commit v2.3.0 CHECK-3: delegates to gitleaks (protect --staged) when installed, with graceful regex fallback; .env-file guard now runs in every mode; fallback pattern set broadened (OpenAI sk-, Slack xox, generic Bearer, Google OAuth refresh, JWT) — all patterns verified non-self-matching so the hooks can scan themselves.
hooks/pre-commit v2.3.0 CHECK-4: prohibited patterns containing spaces are no longer truncated (awk print-third-field bug); per-check verdict no longer suppressed by failures in earlier checks.

hooks/commit-msg v2.2.0: SYNDICATE_REQUIRE_TRACE_HASH=1 opt-in strict mode — hashless legacy trailers become hard failures; default remains warn-and-accept. Migration path toward the evidence-bound flag day.
shims/pi.shim.json: models_verified_on dates, verification notes, and a model_refresh_procedure added to cli_profile — model-slug rot is now visible and has a documented refresh path (L-9).
shims/claude.shim.json: --dangerously-skip-permissions removed from the default Lead cli_flags; security-posture comment documents the project-local opt-in path (L-7).
Core-repo .claude permission posture: git wildcard replaced with an explicit verb allowlist; destructive git operations now prompt (L-6, machine-local — gitignored).

versions.description: Mechanism Debt Payoff. Phase 2 of the Consigliere remediation (CONSIGLIERE_REVIEW_2026-06-10.md): converts documented-but-unimplemented behaviors into working, tested mechanisms — schema v2 with shim validation, the RESERVATIONS concurrency tool, evidence-bound audit traces, hydration-script robustness, and an honest session-manager downscope. No identity files were modified.
changelog: Schema v2 (routing.schema.json 2.0.0, backward-compatible): pi backend, openrouter provider, optional operative/consigliere agent keys, cli_profile/invocation_template/identity_injection properties, route_to extended. All four shims now validate.
Added scripts/validate-shims.sh — python3-jsonschema validator with jq structural fallback; wired into pre-commit v2.2.0 as CHECK-6 (runs when staged changes touch shims/*.json).

Added scripts/reserve.sh — working RESERVATIONS mechanism (claim/release/status/sweep, 4-hour expiry, dead-PID sweep, atomic jq writes); syndicate-init.sh stamps RESERVATIONS.json into mission vaults; ORACLE template §6.3 now mandates the tool over manual JSON edits.

Added scripts/audit-trace.sh — evidence-bound audit traces: appends a hashed audit entry to AUDIT_LOG.md and emits a 3-field trailer; commit-msg hook v2.1.0 verifies trailer hashes against the branch audit log (transitional: hashless legacy trailers warn but pass).

syndicate-init.sh hardened: pi shim deployable via --shim; removed nonexistent --read-only-bash injection that broke Gavel invocation; sed-escaping of operator/project/mission input; deployment registry moved from manifest.json to gitignored deployments.local.json (hydration no longer dirties the core repo); --yes/-y headless flag.

syndicate-session.sh v2.1.0 honest downscope: pre-types correct launch commands into tmux windows without auto-executing (operator confirms with Enter); removed fabricated --system-file/--context flags, dead CMD_LEAD code, and the variable-scope bug that left identity paths empty.

sops/TASK_HYGIENE_SOP.md v1.1: phantom toolchain references (task-hygiene.py, task-graph.yaml, ORACLE §7.1) removed; manual procedure aligned to the project-map.json task_queue that actually exists; future automation tracked as finding M-2.
sops/CONTEXT_HYGIENE.md: positional ORACLE §6.4 reference replaced with named Session Resource Budget reference.

versions.description: Governance True-Up & Launch Protocol Consolidation. Registers all unversioned changes since v3.4.0, remediates the Phase 0 and Phase 1 findings of the 2026-06-10 Consigliere review (CONSIGLIERE_REVIEW_2026-06-10.md), consolidates the triplicated Operative Launch Protocol into a single SOP, removes orphaned files, and corrects the manifest registry itself.
changelog: Registered previously unversioned changes from commit 4a49554: PHASE: PRODUCT DESIGN in THE_LEAD.md, §IX Frontend Hygiene Audit in THE_GAVEL.md, templates/UX_AUDIT_PROMPT.md, ORACLE.md §4.5–4.7 and §6.4.

Phase 0 remediation: pre-commit placeholder detection broadened to all {{...}} tokens; commit-msg hook no longer accepts @gavel FAIL trailers; THE_LEAD.md model binding corrected to Claude Sonnet 4.6+; THE_LEDGER.md Refusal Condition 7 (No Task Absorption); Syndicate hooks installed in the core repo (self-application).
hooks/pre-commit: fixed CHECK-3 secrets scan — patterns beginning with a dash (private key header) were parsed by grep as options and silently skipped; patterns are now passed with -e.

Added sops/OPERATIVE_LAUNCH_PROTOCOL.md v1.0 — single canonical launch protocol (tier selection, tier-to-model mapping, governor behavior, dispatch syntax). Removed the three duplicated protocol blocks from Lead, Ledger, and Gavel; resolved Gavel's direct-invocation contradiction — all launches route through scripts/launch-operative.sh.
Identity version bumps: THE_LEAD.md 3.1→3.2, THE_LEDGER.md 3.0→3.1, THE_GAVEL.md 2.0→2.1 (duplicate §X numbering fixed), THE_OPERATIVE.md header corrected 1.0→1.1.
manifest.json: canonical_branch corrected to main; superseded version entries collapsed to changelog-only; unimplemented sha256_manifest integrity field removed.
Removed orphaned files: shims/gavel_audit.py (crashed on first run, dead quota logic), identities/THE_LEDGER.json (referenced by nothing).
Registered previously untracked assets: sops/TASK_HYGIENE_SOP.md, templates/UX_AUDIT_PROMPT.md, templates/RESERVATIONS.json, and a scripts registry.
Shims: syndicate_version field redefined as the core version the shim was authored against; all four shims stamped 3.5.0; shims/pi.shim.json registered.

versions.description: Agent Safety & Concurrency Control. Introduces templates/RESERVATIONS.json and §6.3 Agent Safety Rules to ORACLE.md. Formalizes the @consigliere identity for strategic analysis and anti-pattern detection. Implements a mission-scoped task reservation registry to prevent resource collisions in multi-agent environments.
changelog: Added templates/RESERVATIONS.json v1.0 — Dynamic task reservation registry to track active agent locks and resources.
Updated templates/ORACLE.md — Added §6.3 Agent Safety & Concurrency Rules (v1.0) defining the reservation protocol, mutation guards, and task expiry rules.
Formalized identities/THE_CONSIGLIERE.md v1.0 — Strategic Advisor identity for pattern analysis and Syndicate governance.
Updated manifest.json — Promoted to v3.4.0 with comprehensive agent safety integration.

versions.description: Test Doctrine Integration. Introduces templates/TEST_DOCTRINE.md as a two-tier testing specification system. Universal philosophy in the core template; project-specific instantiation in .syndicate/TEST_DOCTRINE.md at hydration time. Extends syndicate-init.sh to stamp the template, updates the pre-commit hook to enforce doctrine integrity, and wires ORACLE.md §4 to reference the doctrine file.
changelog: Added templates/TEST_DOCTRINE.md v1.0 — Universal test taxonomy (Unit/Service/Endpoint/Integration), five composability axioms (AX-1 through AX-5), Gavel audit criteria for test quality, test organization standards, and placeholder sections for project-specific instantiation.

Updated scripts/syndicate-init.sh v2.1 — Added Step 4.1: stamps TEST_DOCTRINE.md from template into .syndicate/ at project hydration time, substituting PROJECT_NAME, SYNDICATE_VERSION, HYDRATION_DATE, and OPERATOR_NAME. Updated Step 6 to include test_doctrine path in config.json. Updated mission mode (Step 12) to also stamp TEST_DOCTRINE.md into mission vault.

Updated hooks/pre-commit v2.1 — Added CHECK-5: Test Doctrine Integrity. Verifies .syndicate/TEST_DOCTRINE.md exists (WARN if absent) and contains no unfilled {{placeholder}} tokens (FAIL if present). Updated check count from 4 to 5.
Updated templates/ORACLE.md — Added §4.4 Testing Doctrine with TEST_DOCTRINE path reference and description of the Doctrine's role relative to coverage thresholds.

versions.description: Efficiency Tier Integration. Adds Phase 0 Confidence Gate, Surgical Scope, and Tool Minimalism (Silent Drip) to @lead and @operative. Formalizes sub-agent model routing in the Delegation Matrix. Introduces sops/CONTEXT_HYGIENE.md as an operator SOP for session lifecycle management. Adds Session Resource Budget to ORACLE.md template.
changelog: Updated THE_LEAD.md v3.1 — Added Phase 0: Confidence Gate with explicit trigger conditions and interrogation protocol before any execution phase.

version_schema.description: Schema for future version entries. All versions must conform to this structure.

fields.version: Semver string (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH). MAJOR = breaking identity changes. MINOR = new features, new agents, new shims. PATCH = fixes to existing files.
fields.agents: Map of agent handle to identity version, file path, and default model.
fields.shims_available: Array of shim config file paths included in this version.
fields.compatibility: Minimum required model versions and CLI tools.

deployment_registry.description: Projects that have been hydrated from this Syndicate core. Entries are added by syndicate-init.sh at hydration time. This allows retroactive auditing of which Syndicate version was active for any given project.
